name: send
description: The commit control: the composer's filled control while the field holds content. A word, 'Save', not a glyph. Same height and fill as the microphone it replaces.

label.description: Final copy, 'Save'. Set in printed caps by the CSS.

aria.description: The control's accessible name, default "Save entry". false leaves the visible label to name it (11-states' draft view, as drawn).

states.active: yes: pressed 1px down, and scaled .97 under the shell's motion
states.disabled: n/a: it only exists while there is something to save
states.selected: n/a: it has no on or off
states.loading: n/a: saving is not shown on the control
states.error: n/a: the composer's notice says when saving failed
states.empty: n/a: it only exists while the field holds content

a11y.keyboard: Tab to it, Space or Enter
a11y.labels: aria-label 'Save entry' beside the visible word

changelog.change: Content aria: the accessible name is optional (11-states' draft has none).
